intelligence.essence: The free weekly limit is 100% used (resets Nov 26 12:22 PM MST); additional tokens 19% used, 8B left — roughly 1.9B used in a few days, and his "couple billion in a few days" estimate is about right. Where it goes: maker→checker→eye cycles re-reading and re-proving the whole 10 MB page each round, rework when rounds go back (fix-5/6/7), background loops, and agents sitting idle waiting on other rounds. Waste named: rework + re-proving the whole page + idle waits. Fix ordered: whole-list rounds, prove only what changed. Proof has a price — so scope the proof to the change.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you read the WHOLE big book every single time, sweetheart — even when only one little page changed! That's a lot of reading, sweetheart, and it uses up all your reading time! So now we only read the page that changed, sweetheart — and we check the rest just enough to know it's still fine.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — every time we checked the work, dear, we read the whole ten-pound book from cover to cover, even when only one page was new. No wonder the reading ran out, love! So now we read just the changed page, dear, and we check the rest with a quick glance. Same care, love — much less reading.
